entries.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup for a seated VR training game, one polished first-person concept frame, landscape 4:3. Input image is the current hospital lobby screenshot, an architectural reference and edit target for background. Preserve the bright hospital atrium, glass facade, white columns, stone floor, teal kiosks and eye-level perspective. REMOVE the huge black panel and bottom red hands. Design a restrained in-world chapter-selection composition after the welcome screen: keep at least upper 60 percent of scene clear. Lower foreground has only THREE compact slim white frosted rectangular chapter tabs arranged in a shallow reachable arc, not a wall or dashboard grid, subtle teal selected edge, soft realistic depth and shadows, coherent modest corner radius, crisp large dark Chinese labels. Exact tab labels: '办公室' on left, '储存库' in center, '候诊区' on right. Center selected tab has small text '前往储存库'. Left tab small text '回查'. Right tab small text '稍后开放'. No scores, stars or progress bars. A small compact dialogue strip offset above left side of arc, only two lines with exact text: '安小卫' and '接下来，看看内镜如何存放。'. Do not invent or depict a new fairy character; this frame focuses on panel layout. Do not create any selectable hospital lobby tab. No decorative sci-fi beams, portals, glowing rings, neon, giant floating boards, bubbles, dense lists, development notes, diagrams or extra text. Hospital backdrop must remain dominant. Conceptual spatial layout image only; no claims of runtime screenshot.
